evidence.quote: Courses are held in English and German.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 800 EUR

From summer term 2026, Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt (THI) charges tuition fees of 800 euros per semester for Bachelor and 1.200 euros per semester for Master students from third countries* in accordance with Art. 13 (3), sentence 1, no. 6 Bavarian Higher Education Innovation Act (BayHIG).
This is a secondary school-leaving certificate equivalent to the German "Abitur" that entitles you to study at a German university.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page says 800 EUR (not stated per semester there) for non-EU applicants, while THI's third-country fee page says 800 euros per semester for Bachelor students from third countries from summer term 2026; the value above uses the THI page's semester figure. English is listed by THI as the programme's "Main teaching language" on the programme page, but the DAAD page and the course content (many German module titles in semesters 1-3, "Around half of the courses are taught in English") show German and English are both used.
